bodycontrol.detail: 3–5 min easy movement, wrist circles, wall slides and easy versions of today’s movements.
2 × 5–8 controlled reps; choose assistance that leaves 2–3 reps in reserve.
2 × 6–12; adjust hand elevation for controlled reps with 2–3 in reserve.
2–3 min easy walking and comfortable mobility.

athletepractice.detail: Use only running and jumping levels already tolerated. 5–8 min easy movement, ankle rocks, marching and gradual practice reps. If pain changes your movement, stop that drill.
2 × 10 sec, low amplitude; omit if not tolerated.
4 × 10 m at a familiar submaximal effort; walk back, then recover fully. This starting template is not a prescription for maximal sprinting.
2 × 3 at a familiar effort; stick the landing. Stop if quality drops.
At review, progress one element: quality, reps, distance or intensity. Do not increase everything together.
3–5 min walk and easy calf/hip mobility.

combatintro.detail: Book a beginner session with a qualified BJJ, boxing or Muay Thai coach. Start with one discipline.

combatintro.n: Tell the coach your starting point
combatintro.detail: Discuss experience, limitations and the rest of your weekly training.
Follow the coach’s warmup, technical practice and level-appropriate partner work. This template does not prescribe sparring.
Assess how the class affects the next lifting session before adding another class.

waterpractice.detail: Arrange an instructor assessment; use an appropriate supervised setting.
Follow the instructor’s plan for breathing, floating, stroke technique and safe entry/exit. No solo underwater or breath-hold drills.
Let demonstrated skill determine distance and difficulty, not a preset calendar.

carrypractice.detail: 5 min easy walking, comfortable shoulder and hip movement, then one light carry.
3 × 20–30 m at a manageable load; stop before posture or grip breaks.
10–15 min at a conversational pace. Keep this unweighted initially; loaded hiking is a separate progression.
2–3 min easy movement. Review grip, feet and recovery before progressing.

practicalskills.detail: CPR/AED, first aid, bleeding-control training or navigation.
Use the provider’s curriculum and practical assessment.
Retain your course record and renewal date outside the workout history.
